answer: Work waits on the willow until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the zenith of the next round. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, released only after three unrelated confirmations, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. By the ripple of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
